title: Alondra1 note (v1)
description: A note, private to its owner within a space. Plain-text notes (title/body) from older clients stay valid; rich notes add doc (note-document-v1), folder, favorite/archive/trash state, picture assets and links. Written by the Windows and Android apps and synced through /v1/sync and /v1/notes.

id.description: Client id: 32 lowercase hex characters from Alondra1 apps.

title.description: Optional; clients derive a display title from the first body line when empty.

body.description: Plain text. For rich notes, the text of doc (search, previews, older clients).

folderId.description: note_folder id; null or missing = no folder. A missing folder shows the note in All Notes.

archivedUtc.description: Set while the note is archived.

trashedUtc.description: Set while the note is in Trash; clients delete it for good after the retention period (default 30 days).

assets.description: SHA-256 ids of the pictures doc references (uploaded with PUT /v1/note-assets/{id}).

links.description: References to other Alondra1 objects. Targets are checked by whoever opens them; a missing target is shown as unavailable.
